summary: Wii Fit entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Wii Fit
entries.definitive_edition: Wii Fit Plus with Wii Balance Board

emulation.emulator: Dolphin only if Balance Board support is verified
emulation.notes: Original Wii/Wii U hardware is preferable because the Balance Board is central to the experience.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Wii hardware or Wii U backward compatibility with original Balance Board

primary.version: Wii Fit Plus with Wii Balance Board
primary.why: Wii Fit Plus is an enhanced Wii release that includes the original Wii Fit activities plus additional routines and activities, making it the practical completeness route. The Wii Balance Board is required for the authentic control/fitness experience.
primary.how_to_play: Use Wii hardware or Wii U backward compatibility with a calibrated Wii Balance Board. Record Wii Fit vs Wii Fit Plus disc, board condition/sync, user profile/BMI data handling, region, and whether original Wii Fit menu/progression behavior is being preserved.

all_releases.fidelity: Original Wii Balance Board exergame release.
all_releases.reason: skip: preserve for historical UI/profile comparison; Wii Fit Plus is the broader activity route.

all_releases.fidelity: Expanded Wii route with original activities and additional routines/activities.
all_releases.reason: primary: best completeness route for the Wii Fit activity set.

all_releases.fidelity: Wii U successor using the Balance Board plus Fit Meter ecosystem.
all_releases.reason: skip: separate successor, not a replacement for the original Wii Fit entry.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Wii Fit Plus is more complete, but the original Wii Fit disc remains the exact 2007 artifact.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record profile data and hardware calibration. Treat Wii Fit U as a successor rather than a transparent replacement.
